question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are longer than 10 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 600000

question: List the first and last names of all customers from Brazil.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: What media types are tracks available in?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: What is the highest unit price of any track?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track

question: How many invoices were billed to the UK?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'United Kingdom'

question: Which employees work as Sales Support Agents?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: What is the total amount billed across all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many customers do not have a company listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NULL

question: Which cities in the United States have customers?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA'

question: How many hip hop tracks are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Hip Hop/Rap'

question: How many playlists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist

question: How many tracks are there in each genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 billing countries by total revenue, from highest to lowest?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which album has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: How many customers does each support rep look after?
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId

question: Which genre has the longest average track length?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY AVG(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many invoices were issued in 2011?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2011'

question: What was the total revenue for each year?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1

question: Which month of 2010 had the highest revenue? Give it as YYYY-MM.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total spending?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which playlists contain more than 1000 tracks? Show each playlist's id and name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000

question: Which employee has the most direct reports?
gold_sql: SELECT m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo GROUP BY m.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: For every employee who has a manager, show the employee's name and their manager's name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ReportsTo

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: List the customers who have never bought a Rock track.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock')

question: What percentage of all sales revenue came from Rock tracks? Round to one decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.Name = 'Rock' THEN il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity ELSE 0 END) / SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 1) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId

question: Which support rep's customers generated the most invoice revenue in 2012?
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) = '2012' GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artist has earned the most revenue from track sales?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: On average, how many tracks are on an invoice? Round to two decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS n FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY InvoiceId)

question: How many albums have a total running time of more than two hours?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AlbumId FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING SUM(Milliseconds) > 7200000)

question: Which customers have spent more than the average customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId))

question: For each year, which genre sold the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT y, g FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) AS y, gr.Name AS g, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC) AS rk FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre gr ON gr.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY y, gr.GenreId) WHERE rk = 1

question: Which month had the largest increase in revenue compared with the month before? Give it as YYYY-MM.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS ym, SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY ym) SELECT ym FROM (SELECT ym, s - LAG(s) OVER (ORDER BY ym) AS d FROM m) ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 1

question: For each country, which customer or customers spent the most? Include ties.
gold_sql: SELECT Country, FirstName, LastName FROM (SELECT c.Country, c.FirstName, c.LastName, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.Country ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC) AS rk FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId) WHERE rk = 1

question: Which of Jane Peacock's customers has spent the most?
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS tot FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId WHERE e.FirstName = 'Jane' AND e.LastName = 'Peacock' GROUP BY c.CustomerId) SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM s WHERE tot = (SELECT MAX(tot) FROM s)

question: How many tracks appear in at least 5 different playlists?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT TrackId FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PlaylistId) >= 5)

question: How many artists have tracks in more than one genre?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.ArtistId FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 1)
